notes: v7.5.0 — Documentation & Logging Overhaul Release. (1) PMP-standard documentation suite: new SYSTEM_SPEC.md (50+ functional requirements, 71 non-functional requirements, system boundaries, constraints, acceptance criteria, glossary), new PROGRAM_SPEC.md (5-layer MVC architecture, module specs for all 14 controllers/17 services/18 pages, data flow diagrams, integration points, logging specification, security considerations), new TECHNICAL_GUIDE.md (environment setup, project structure, build & deployment, coding standards, step-by-step guides for adding pages/API endpoints/AI engines, logging usage examples, troubleshooting, version management). (2) Updated USER_GUIDE.md from v5.4.0 to v7.5.0 (25 sections covering all 18 pages, GLOBAL AUTO, 10 strategy presets, lyrics engine, studios, library, quality analyzer, batch gen, analytics, audio player, settings, auth, history, i18n, tips, FAQ, troubleshooting). (3) Updated README.md from v5.4.0 to v7.5.0 (badges, 3 AI engines, live demo links, feature highlights, tech stack table, quick start, project structure, mobile apps, deployment, config, API reference, documentation table linking all 10 docs, screenshots, repo/contact). (4) Updated PMP_PROJECT_PLAN.md from v1.0.0 to v7.5.0 (all 8 phases marked complete, 13 sprints, full version history, updated risk register, issue log summary, updated resources to zwindhuang@qq.com/zwindhuang-opc/zmusic, pinned ports 4720/4721). (5) Updated ISSUE_LOG.md with v7.x resolved issues and v7.5.0 entries. (6) Log4j-style logging enhanced: added FileAppender class to src/utils/logger.js with rolling 5MB file rotation, wired into server.js to persist all server logs to logs/server.log (console + file dual appender). (7) i18n cleanup: migrated remaining hardcoded strings (Edge CDP, Restart App, Retry Render, etc.) to t() i18n calls across App.jsx, main.jsx, and 15 other component/page files with 75+ new translation keys added to en.json/zh.json. (8) Browser verification: 11+ pages verified working without console errors.
